tools.name: wiki_retrieve

Page results include webUrl: a browser link requiring normal workspace access. Use it for citations; it does not make the page public.

tools.name: wiki_create_page
tools.description: Create a wiki page under a space. Pass EITHER `markdown` (simpler, server converts to TipTap) OR `content` (TipTap/ProseMirror JSON, mutually exclusive with markdown). Use `content` when you need rich features that markdown can't express — banners, collapsibles, mermaid diagrams, action buttons, inl

tools.name: wiki_update_page
tools.description: Update an existing wiki page by slug. Any field left unset preserves the current value. Pass EITHER `markdown` OR `content` (TipTap/ProseMirror JSON) for the body — they're mutually exclusive. Use `content` for rich features (banners, collapsibles, mermaid, etc.); call get_endpoint_examples(tag="Wik

tools.name: wiki_enable_page_share

tools.name: wiki_disable_page_share
tools.description: Disable the public share link for a single page, revoking access via its URL (returns 204). Requires edit access. API-key scope: `wiki:pages:write`.

tools.name: wiki_list_spaces
tools.description: List every wiki space the caller can see in the current workspace. Each entry has the space's `key` (use this in subsequent calls), `name`, `description`, `effectivePermission` (view/edit/admin), and `canView`/`canEdit`/`canAdmin` booleans for quick gating. Call this first when an agent needs to fig

tools.name: wiki_get_space
tools.description: Fetch a single wiki space by key. Returns the WikiSpaceDTO (id, key, name, description, icon, color, cover image, visibility flags, permissions, timestamps). For the page tree inside the space, use wiki_get_space_with_pages instead. API-key scope: `wiki:spaces:read`.

tools.name: wiki_get_space_with_pages
tools.description: Fetch a wiki space AND its complete page tree in one call. Returns WikiSpaceWithPagesDTO — space metadata plus `pages` (a recursive tree of WikiPageTreeNodeDTO with slug, title, type=page|folder, hasChildren, children[], view count, top reactions, the caller's effectivePermission per node). Use this

tools.name: wiki_create_space
tools.description: Create a new wiki space in the current workspace. `key` is the unique short identifier used in URLs and subsequent API calls — uppercase letters + digits only, 2-20 chars, must start with a letter (e.g. "DOCS", "ENG2"). `name` is the human display name. Defaults: `isPublic: true` (INTERNAL visibilit

tools.name: wiki_update_space
tools.description: Update a wiki space's metadata. All fields are optional — pass only what you want to change. The space key cannot be changed. Requires edit access to the space. API-key scope: `wiki:spaces:write`.

tools.name: wiki_delete_space
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a wiki space AND every page inside it. Requires admin access to the space. This is destructive — surface a clear confirmation to the user before calling. Returns 204. API-key scope: `wiki:spaces:write`.

tools.name: wiki_get_public_settings
tools.description: Get a space's PUBLIC-WEB publishing settings (PublicSpaceSettingsDTO): `isEnabled` (is the space published to the public internet), `customSlug` (public URL slug), `allowedEmojis`, `showReactions`, `showPageViews`, `showLastUpdated`, `showAuthor`, `viewMode` ("space"|"helpcenter"), `heroTitle`, `her

tools.name: wiki_check_public_slug
tools.description: Check whether a public URL slug is available and validly formatted for a space, before publishing. Returns a SlugAvailabilityDTO. Call this when choosing a `customSlug` for wiki_set_public_settings. Requires space admin. API-key scope: `wiki:spaces:read`.

tools.name: wiki_set_public_settings
tools.description: Publish / unpublish a space to the PUBLIC INTERNET, or update its public-site config. This is the REAL publish switch — NOT the space `isPublic` flag (which is internal visibility). Pass only the fields you want to change: `isEnabled` (true = publish to the web, false = take offline), `customSlug` (

tools.name: wiki_list_attachments
tools.description: List every attachment on a wiki page (WikiAttachmentDTO[]): id, pageId, filename, contentType, sizeBytes, status (pending|confirmed|failed), uploadedBy/At, confirmedAt. `pageId` is the page UUID (from wiki_get_space_with_pages tree node `id`, not the slug). Use to find an attachmentId to reference o

tools.name: wiki_request_attachment_upload
tools.description: Step 1 of uploading an image/file to a wiki page. Returns { attachmentId, uploadUrl, storageKey }. AFTER calling this you MUST: (2) PUT the raw file bytes to `uploadUrl` with your OWN HTTP client — the MCP server cannot do this binary upload — sending the EXACT same `Content-Type` as `contentType` a

tools.name: wiki_confirm_attachment
tools.description: Step 3 of uploading: confirm that the bytes were successfully PUT to the presigned `uploadUrl`, activating the attachment. Returns the WikiAttachmentDTO (status becomes "confirmed"). Call only after the byte PUT succeeded. API-key scope: `wiki:attachments:write`.

tools.name: wiki_delete_attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete an attachment and its stored file (returns 204). Useful for cleaning up unused or leftover uploads. This does not remove image nodes that still reference it in a page body — update the page content separately if needed. API-key scope: `wiki:attachments:write`.

tools.name: fr_list_requests
tools.description: List feature requests on a feedback board (by board slug). Filter by status / category / milestone name (lenient — trimmed + case-insensitive). Pass `q` to search request titles instead. Paginated via page/size. API-key scope: `feedback:requests:read`.

tools.name: fr_get_request
tools.description: Get a feature request by short ID (e.g. "FR-42"). Returns full detail: title, description, status, category, milestone, voteCount, commentCount, reactions. Internal notes and linkedTaskIds are populated only when the caller has `View Internal Data` permission. API-key scope: `feedback:requests:read`

tools.name: fr_create_request
tools.description: Create a new feature request on a board. Category is resolved by name (lenient match). No turnstile token required — API-key authentication is sufficient. Returns the new request with assigned shortId. API-key scope: `feedback:requests:write`.

tools.name: fr_set_request_status
tools.description: Change a feature request's status by name. The name is resolved leniently against the request's board's status set (trim + case-insensitive). Returns the updated request detail. API-key scope: `feedback:requests:write`.

tools.name: fr_comment_request
tools.description: Add a comment to a feature request. Pass isInternal=true to make the comment visible only to users with `View Internal Data` permission. API-key scope: `feedback:comments:write`.

tools.name: fr_vote_request
tools.description: Toggle a vote or emoji reaction on a feature request. Passing emoji=null or omitting the field registers a plain upvote. Calling the tool again with the same emoji removes the vote (idempotent toggle). API-key scope: `feedback:votes:write`.

tools.name: fr_moderate_request
tools.description: Approve, reject, or mark a feature request as spam. Action is case-insensitive. Requires `Manage Queue` permission. API-key scope: `feedback:moderation:write`.

tools.name: fr_delete_request
tools.description: Permanently delete a feature request. Requires `Manage Queue` permission. Returns 204 on success. This operation is irreversible — confirm with the user before calling unless the intent is unambiguous. API-key scope: `feedback:requests:write`.

tools.name: fr_list_bugs
tools.description: List bug reports on a feedback board (by board slug). Filter by severity and/or status name (lenient match). API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:read`.

tools.name: fr_get_bug
tools.description: Get a bug report by short ID (e.g. "BG-99"). Returns full detail: title, reproduction steps, expected/actual result, severity, status, product area, assignee, affectedCount, environment, comments count. Internal notes and linkedIssueUrl populated only for `View Internal Data` permission. API-key sco

tools.name: fr_create_bug
tools.description: Create a new bug report on a board. Severity and productArea are resolved by name (lenient match). Environment is a free-form map (browser, OS, url, etc.). API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: fr_set_bug_status
tools.description: Change a bug status by name (lenient match against the board's bug-status set). API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: fr_set_bug_assignee
tools.description: Assign or unassign a bug. Provide `assigneeEmail` (resolved case-insensitive against workspace members) OR `assigneeId` (UUID). Exactly one; both = 400. Passing neither unassigns. API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: fr_set_bug_visibility
tools.description: Toggle a bug's public visibility. Security bugs stay private regardless. API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: fr_toggle_bug_affected
tools.description: Toggle the caller's "I'm affected" marker on a bug. Returns the updated bug detail with new affectedCount. API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: fr_comment_bug
tools.description: Add a comment to a bug report. Pass isInternal=true for internal-only. API-key scope: `feedback:comments:write`.

tools.name: fr_moderate_bug
tools.description: Approve, reject, or mark a bug as spam. Action is case-insensitive. Requires `Manage Queue` permission. API-key scope: `feedback:moderation:write`.

tools.name: fr_delete_bug
tools.description: Permanently delete a bug report. Requires `Manage Queue` permission. Irreversible. API-key scope: `feedback:bugs:write`.

tools.name: pm_get_workspace_context
tools.description: Single-call workspace orientation: members, spaces (with folders, lists, per-list statuses/priorities/taskTypes/customFields), workspace-level taskTypes, relationshipTypes, tags. The biggest agent-onboarding tool — call it first when starting in a new workspace. Folders nest at any depth: every fold

tools.name: pm_get_dashboard
tools.description: Get aggregated counts and breakdowns (status / priority / assignee distributions, custom-field summaries) for any scope. Useful for "how is project X doing?" questions without paginating through tasks. API-key scope: `dashboards:read`.

tools.name: pm_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks across the workspace with name-based filters. status / priority / tag / taskType are repeatable (pass an array). assignee is an email or UUID. q is a free-text search over title + description. Returns a cursor-paginated page of LiteTaskResponse — pass nextCursor back as `cursor` to pagi

tools.name: pm_get_task
tools.description: Fetch a task by ref. Ref accepts a system identifier (tsk_…) OR a task key (e.g. 'PROJ-42'). Returns LiteTaskResponse with names instead of UUIDs and emails instead of user UUIDs. Internal note: when ref is a task key the workspace query param is required — the MCP injects it automatically. Present

tools.name: pm_get_subtasks
tools.description: List the direct subtasks (one level deep) of a parent task by ref. API-key scope: `tasks:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_task
tools.description: Create a task. In the result, title/webUrl are for presentation; displayKey is the optional visible key. Keep key/identifier for API calls and do not expose a hidden raw key in the summary. References are name-based: status/priority/level/taskType are names; assignees are emails; tags are strings (a

tools.name: pm_update_task
tools.description: Partial-update a task by ref. Only fields present in the call are changed. Pass an explicit null to clear nullable fields (dueDate, parent, taskType, etc.). Names resolve leniently against the current effective set. To change just the type and nothing else, prefer this with `taskType` set; use `pm_b

tools.name: pm_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task by ref. Cascade-deletes subtasks. Requires FULL access (not just EDIT). Returns 204 on success. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_list_task_types
tools.description: Return the workspace task-type catalogue (identifier, name, singularName, pluralName, iconKind, iconValue, color, sortOrder, origin SYSTEM/CUSTOM). Use this to discover what types are available before creating/updating tasks, or to translate names to stable identifiers for the cascade-default endpoi

tools.name: pm_bulk_change_task_type
tools.description: Change the task type for many tasks at once (≤5000 per call). `taskIdentifiers` are stable wire identifiers (e.g. tsk_…) — task keys (PROJ-42) are NOT accepted here; use pm_search_tasks first if you only have keys. `taskType` is a name (e.g. "Bug") or null to clear the type. Returns 200 sync for ≤50

tools.name: pm_list_task_comments
tools.description: List comments on a task by ref. Cursor-paginated. API-key scope: `tasks:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_task_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task. `mentions` is an array of emails — the server resolves them to user UUIDs and substitutes `@<email>` literals in `text` with mention spans. Pass `replyTo` (a comment identifier) to thread. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_update_task_comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment. Only the original author may edit. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_task_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment. Only the original author may delete. Returns 204. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_list_task_relationships
tools.description: List all relationships where the task is owner OR child. Cursor-paginated. API-key scope: `tasks:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_task_relationship
tools.description: Create a relationship from one task to another. `type` is the relationship-type name in the workspace (e.g. "Blocking"). `target` is a task key or identifier. The current task (ref) is the owner. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_task_relationship
tools.description: Delete a relationship by identifier. Returns 204. API-key scope: `tasks:write`.

tools.name: pm_create_space
tools.description: Create a new space in the current workspace. Description / icon / color / isPrivate are optional metadata. Returns LiteSpaceResponse. API-key scope: `spaces:write`.

tools.name: pm_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder inside a space. Space identified by name. API-key scope: `folders:write`.

tools.name: pm_update_folder
tools.description: Update folder metadata by identifier (fld_…). All fields optional. API-key scope: `folders:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_folder
tools.description: Soft-delete a folder and its child lists+tasks. Requires FULL access. 204. API-key scope: `folders:write`.

tools.name: pm_create_list
tools.description: Create a task list inside a space (optionally inside a folder). Space and folder are identified by name. Omit folder to create the list directly under the space. Prefer setting icon and color on create when the list purpose is known. For icon, prefer a semantic emoji name first; use an icon identifi

tools.name: pm_update_list
tools.description: Update list metadata by identifier (tl_…). All fields optional. API-key scope: `lists:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_list
tools.description: Soft-delete a list and its tasks. Requires FULL access. 204. API-key scope: `lists:write`.

tools.name: pm_create_custom_field
tools.description: Create a custom field at workspace / space / list scope. scope=workspace ignores scopeName; scope=space takes a space name; scope=list takes a list name (first match in the workspace). For dropdown / labels (multi-select) types, pass `options` as an array of {value, color?, emoji?, orderIndex?}. Kee

tools.name: pm_update_custom_field
tools.description: Update custom-field metadata (name / description / emoji / color / isPrivate). API-key scope: `custom_fields:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_custom_field
tools.description: Delete a custom field and all its values. Requires FULL access. 204. API-key scope: `custom_fields:write`.

tools.name: pm_list_views
tools.description: List views at a given scope. scope is one of workspace/space/folder/list; scopeIdentifier is the UUID of the parent entity (omit for workspace scope — the MCP's configured workspace is used). Cursor-paginated. API-key scope: `views:read`.

tools.name: pm_get_view
tools.description: Fetch a view by identifier (vw_…). API-key scope: `views:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_view
tools.description: Create a view. type is one of list / board / table / dashboard / gantt / calendar / gallery. For a newly created list, prefer configuring its auto-created primary view with pm_update_view; add another view only for a distinct workflow. ALWAYS pass `columns` listing exactly what should be visible, in

tools.name: pm_update_view
tools.description: Update a view, including the auto-created primary List view when finishing list setup. Configure useful column order, grouping, and sorting instead of leaving a defaults-only view. filters / columns use FilterGroupDTO / ColumnOrderItem shapes. Sending columns replaces the entire selection/order: inc

tools.name: pm_delete_view
tools.description: Delete a view by identifier. Mandatory views (system-created defaults) return 409 Conflict. Returns 204 on success. API-key scope: `views:write`.

tools.name: pm_clone_view
tools.description: Clone an existing view into a (possibly different) scope. Requires VIEW on the source and EDIT on the target scope. API-key scope: `views:write`.

tools.name: pm_list_sprint_groups
tools.description: List all sprint groups in a space. Sprint groups are containers for sprints — each group has its own state machine (only one IN_PROGRESS sprint per group). Returns an array of SprintGroupDTO. API-key scope: `sprints:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_sprint_group
tools.description: Create a sprint group inside a space. `name` is required (max 100 chars). `description` is optional (max 2000 chars). `defaultDurationDays` is the default sprint length used when creating new sprints (1–90 days, optional). API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_create_sprint
tools.description: Create a sprint inside a sprint group. New sprints start in NOT_STARTED state. `name` required (max 200 chars). `goal`, `startDate`, `endDate` optional (ISO-8601 instants for dates). API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_get_sprint
tools.description: Fetch a sprint by identifier. Returns SprintDTO with task statistics. API-key scope: `sprints:read`.

tools.name: pm_update_sprint
tools.description: Full update of sprint name, goal, and date window. NOTE: this is a PUT, not a PATCH — fields you omit may be cleared by the backend. Pass every field you want to keep. API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_delete_sprint
tools.description: Soft-delete a sprint. Tasks lose their sprint association but remain in their lists. 204 on success. API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_start_sprint
tools.description: Transition a sprint from NOT_STARTED to IN_PROGRESS. Only ONE sprint per group can be IN_PROGRESS at a time — starting a sprint while another is in progress will fail. No body. API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_complete_sprint
tools.description: Transition a sprint from IN_PROGRESS to DONE. Optionally pass `rolloverSprintIdentifier` to move incomplete tasks into a different sprint (typically the next one in the group). Omit the field to leave incomplete tasks unsorted (no rollover). API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_add_tasks_to_sprint
tools.description: Associate tasks with a sprint. All tasks must belong to the same space as the sprint group. Pass identifiers (tsk_…), not task keys. Returns updated SprintDTO. API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_remove_tasks_from_sprint
tools.description: Remove task-sprint associations. Tasks remain in their lists. Pass identifiers (tsk_…), not task keys. Returns updated SprintDTO. API-key scope: `sprints:write`.

tools.name: pm_get_sprint_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks currently in the sprint. Returns an array of full TaskDTO. API-key scope: `sprints:read`.

tools.name: pm_get_sprint_burndown
tools.description: Return burndown/burnup chart data for the sprint — daily snapshots of remaining vs completed work. Use this to render burndown charts or audit sprint progress over time. API-key scope: `sprints:read`.

tools.name: pm_create_webhook

tools.name: pm_list_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhook subscriptions registered in the current workspace. The HMAC `secret` is NOT included. Pass `url` to return only the webhooks whose URL matches it exactly. Each entry reports scopeType, scopeEntityIdentifier, scopeEntityName and includeSecurityBugs. API-key scope: `webhooks:read`.

tools.name: pm_list_webhook_event_types
tools.description: List every event type a webhook can subscribe to, across Project Management, the wiki (Codexum) and feature requests (Roadmarq). Returns [{type, product ("pm" | "codexum" | "roadmarq"), description, scopes}], where `scopes` are the scopeType values the type can be narrowed by. Use it to pick eventTy

Check this before calling pm_create_webhook in bulk — creatio

tools.name: pm_get_webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook by identifier. Returns its url / name / eventTypes / scope / active flag; does NOT return the HMAC secret (only available at creation time). API-key scope: `webhooks:read`.

tools.name: pm_update_webhook
tools.description: Partial-update a webhook subscription. Only fields present in the call are changed (pass-through PATCH-style semantics). Use `active: false` to pause deliveries without deleting. tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription permanently. Stops all future deliveries. Returns 204. The HMAC secret cannot be recovered — recreate the webhook to get a new one. API-key scope: `webhooks:write`.

tools.name: pm_test_webhook
tools.description: Fire a synthetic test delivery to a webhook on demand, without waiting for a real workspace event. tools.description: List recent delivery attempts for a webhook (most recent first). Each entry includes the event type, response status, attempt count, and timestamps. tools.name: pm_replay_webhook_delivery

tools.description:
Read the activity log for a scope. `scope` selects the entity type and `identifier` is that entity's identifier (use the workspace identifier when scope=workspace). `mode` is either 'full' (this entity AND everything beneath it) or 'own' (this entity only). Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: pm_list_notifications
tools.description: List notifications for the current user in the active workspace. NOTE: this endpoint uses PAGE-style pagination (?page=&size=) not cursor-based — unusual for this API. `page` is 0-indexed; `size` is 1–100. Optional `unreadOnly`, `sortColumn`, `sortDirection`. API-key scope: `notifications:read`.

tools.name: pm_count_unread_notifications
tools.description: Return the bare unread-notification count (a Long) for the current user in the active workspace. The response body is a single number, not an object. API-key scope: `notifications:read`.

tools.name: pm_mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark a single notification as read. Only the notification owner may do this — calling with another user's notification identifier returns an error. API-key scope: `notifications:write`.

tools.name: pm_mark_all_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark every unread notification in the active workspace as read for the current user. API-key scope: `notifications:write`.

tools.name: pm_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries logged against a task. `taskIdentifier` must be a stable identifier (tsk_…), not a task key. Supports page/size/sortColumn/sortDirection (page-style). API-key scope: `time:read`.

tools.name: pm_log_time
tools.description: Log a time entry against a task. `timeSpent` is in minutes (0 to 10080 — 7 days max). `startedAt` is an ISO-8601 instant marking when the tracked work started. `notes` is optional (max 10000 chars).
